cover.concept: A single simple calendar-square shape glowing warmly in bright accent orange, its glow the only light source in the frame, positioned beside a plain rotary-style phone handset rendered in flat muted indigo, resting silent and dark on its cradle with no motion lines or sound marks around it, suggesting a booking that happened without anyone picking up the phone.

inline.name: sorting-standard-custom
inline.concept: A simple geometric doorway or archway shape splitting into two diverging paths rendered as thin flat lines: one path leads to a plain calendar-grid icon glowing in bright accent orange, the other path leads to a simple hand silhouette holding a round magnifying glass over a small blueprint or floor-plan rectangle in muted indigo, showing a single entry point branching into a quick standard route and a slower custom-inspection route.

inline.name: deposit-locks-slot
inline.concept: A small flat coin shape in bright accent orange sliding toward and settling into one glowing square of a calendar grid, with a thin geometric lock or latch motif clicking shut around that square; beside it, one adjacent calendar square is rendered as a faint, semi-transparent outline in muted indigo, fading out to suggest an unclaimed slot disappearing.
